facts.business: Malu Paper Mills Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of paper and paper products.

auditor.name: Demble Ramani & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on net loss of ₹2,157.00 lakhs and negative net worth of ₹2,729.17 lakhs as at 31st March 2026; financial statements prepared on going concern basis based on management's turnaround strategy and promoter fund infusion intention.

key_risks: Prolonged challenging economic and market conditions in the paper industry
Negative net worth and recurring losses
Dependence on management's turnaround strategy and promoter fund infusion for going concern
Related party transactions including indirect acquisition under SEBI Takeover Regulations
Judgment-intensive areas: deferred tax recognition, impairment of assets, recoverability of trade receivables, fair value measurements, provisions and contingent liabilities
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include Sales/Purchases of Goods/Services/Loans & Advances to Associates and other related parties. Identification and disclosure focused due to indirect acquisition pursuant to SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 via open offer for controlling interest. Verified for compliance with secretarial and relevant laws per Note 27.
